build_autoencoder_model: build a Relightable Gaussian Coarse AutoEncoder with encoder, decoder, and geometry modules for 3D face rendering
create_encoder_embeddings: create a joint encoder that produces latent embeddings from registration vertices and color texture maps
decode_geometry_from_embeddings: decode coarse face geometry from latent embeddings using a linear decoder with learned mean and standard deviation
render_gaussian_primitives: render relightable 3D Gaussian primitives with diffuse and specular shading using gsplat rendering
generate_training_summaries: generate diagnostic image summaries including diffuse color, specular color, normals, opacity, and depth for training visualization
